m.d: E is the fifth letter of the alphabet, and is the most common vowel and letter used in the English language.
The grade below D in some grading systems. In most such systems, it is a failing grade.
The constant e is a real number that has formula e= lim _(n→∞)(1+1/n)ⁿ, and is approximately 2.718281828.
